description: Unofficial Oculus fork with Distant Horizons 3.x shader support for Minecraft 1.16.5

mods.name: Oculus DH3 Compat (Unofficial Fork)
mods.description:
Unofficial Oculus 1.16.5 fork with Distant Horizons 3.x compatibility.
Replaces Oculus and must not be installed alongside an official Oculus jar.

releases.notes:
Unofficial Oculus fork with Distant Horizons 3.2.x shader support for Minecraft 1.16.5.

Changes:
- Added DH framebuffer, shader program, depth sampler, opaque pass, and transparent pass integration.
- Reloads DH rendering state when changing dimensions or shader packs.
- Fixed startup when Distant Horizons is not installed.
- Verified with and without DH, with shaders disabled, while switching shader packs, in multiple dimensions, and on AMD and NVIDIA GPUs.

Compatibility:
- Minecraft 1.16.5
- Forge 36.2.29 or newer 36.x builds
- Distant Horizons 3.2.x (3.2.0-b or newer, below 3.3.0)
- Rubidium 0.2.13

Do not install this fork alongside an official Oculus jar.
